Example \(1\)

Evaluate the indefinite integral \(\displaystyle \int 5\,dx\)

Solution

Applying the Constant Rule: \(\displaystyle \int k\,dx=kx+C\)

we have,

\[\displaystyle \int 5\,dx=5x+C\]


Example \(2\)

Evaluate the indefinite integral \(\displaystyle \int 4x\,dx\)

Solution

Apply the power rule of antidifferentiation i.e Power Rule

where \(n\neq -1: \displaystyle \int X^n\,dx=\displaystyle \frac{1}{n+1}X^{n+1}+C\)

We have

\( \begin{align} \displaystyle \int 4x\,dx&=4\int x\,dx\\ &=4 \times \displaystyle \frac{1}{1+1}X^{1+1}+C\\ &=4\times \displaystyle \frac{1}{2}x^2+C\\ &=2x^2+C \end{align} \)
